meta.name: Ensure geo-replicated container registries to match multi-region container deployments.
meta.description: Ensure geo-replicated container registries to match multi-region container deployments.

evaluators.description: azurerm_container_registry.sku must be 'Premium' — geo-replication is a Premium-only feature, so both halves of this policy have to hold.
azurerm_container_registry.georeplications must be a non-empty list. An empty list, or an unresolvable attribute (severity 2 > tolerance 1), both fail.
